question: As notified on 20 June 2025, the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) will soon begin manufacturing new variants of the Pinaka rocket system with extended ranges of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**120 km and 300 km**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the notification on **20 June 2025**, the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** is set to significantly enhance India's artillery reach by developing new variants of the **Pinaka Multi-Barrel Rocket Launcher (MBRL)** system.
 
• The new variants are specifically designed to target assets at distances of **120 km** and **300 km**, representing a major leap from the current operational ranges. ***Hence, the statement regarding the ranges of 120 km and 300 km is correct.***
 
• This development is being spearheaded by the **Armament Research & Development Establishment (ARDE)** in **Pune**, which is the lead laboratory for the **Pinaka** project under the **DRDO**.
 
• The extension to **120 km** and **300 km** is aimed at providing the **Indian Army** with deep-strike capabilities to neutralize enemy logistics, troop concentrations, and communication centers far behind the front lines.
